title: The Lighthouse
intro: Storm tonight. The great light on the cliff is dark, and every ship on this coast is sailing at the rocks. Someone has to climb up there and light it.

cove.name: Wrecker's Cove
cove.desc: Salt spray and black rocks. Your rowboat lies stove-in on the shingle. A boardwalk leads north toward the wharf.

actions.label: wait for rescue
fx: You huddle by the wreck till dawn. No rescue comes; out past the point, timbers split on the reef all night.

wharf.name: Old Wharf
wharf.desc: Rotten planks and tarred nets. The village tavern glows east; a stair cut into the cliff face climbs west toward the dark tower.

tavern.name: The Bell & Anchor
tavern.desc: Low beams, peat smoke, one lamp. The innkeep polishes a glass and watches the weather-glass fall.

keeper_cottage.name: Keeper's Cottage
keeper_cottage.desc: Dust sheets, a cold hearth, charts of the reef pinned to every wall. Something pale waits by the window.

cliff_path.name: Cliff Stair
cliff_path.desc: A hundred worn steps, wind tearing at your coat. The lighthouse door is a black slab above.

lighthouse_base.name: Lighthouse Door
lighthouse_base.desc: The tower's base, iron-banded oak door streaked with salt. Above, the lamp room stands dark against the running clouds.

in.lockedMsg: The iron lock holds fast. You need the keeper's key.

stair.name: Spiral Stair
stair.desc: Stone steps corkscrew up into the tower. An oil store opens off the landing east; the lamp room is up.

oil_store.name: Oil Store
oil_store.desc: Casks and coiled chain. The air is cold in a way that has nothing to do with the sea.

lamp_room.name: Lamp Room
lamp_room.desc: The great mirrored lamp, cold and still. Its winding mechanism is orange with rust. The whole coast lies black below.

actions.label: oil the mechanism
fx: The oil flask empties into the gears; the mechanism turns free.
Your grip slips on the rust-caked gears, and they bite your hand. The mechanism stays seized.

actions.label: light the beacon
fx: Flame takes the wick; mirrors catch it and hurl it out to sea. The beam sweeps the reef, and far out in the dark a ship leans away to safety.

topics.label: the dark tower
topics.say: Old Maren kept that light forty years. Her cottage is just north — and she never parted with the key, not even dead. Go gentle if you go.

topics.label: a sailor's tale
topics.say: They say the thing in the oil store came off a wreck in '09. Take iron if you go up there.

topics.label: farewell
topics.say: Mind the stair. And light it, lad.

topics.label: the iron key
topics.say: You spoke to Aldun first. Good. Take it — and take my lantern. Light her one last time.
fx: Cold iron presses into your palm.

topics.label: her lighthouse
topics.say: Forty winters I climbed those stairs. The gears want oil; the store keeps it. Mind what the store keeps besides.

sea_wight.name: sea-wight
onDeath: The wight collapses into brine and weed. Behind where it stood: an oil flask.

walkthrough: ask keeper's ghost: the iron key
